title: How do PPO and SA-SP compare under the same rules
intro: Actual frozen PPO checkpoints and adapted SA-SP runs use the same circuit, no rotation, integer lower-left anchors, board constraints and independent scoring. Replay controls inspect saved events without running a new search.
table: Which outputs complete legally, and what quality do they achieve
seeds: Each circuit has one argmax run and three sampled PPO inference seeds from training seed 0, plus three independent SA seeds. Quality means and sample standard deviations include complete legal outputs; completion counts retain every trial.
timing: How much computation does each method use
timing_note: Wall time and process CPU time are measured separately. PPO trial timing excludes model loading, one warm-up forward pass and offline training; it includes environment interaction, lightweight tracing and final validation. SA timing includes shelf initialization, temperature probes, search, trace capture and final validation. JSON disk writes are excluded. The methods have different computation budgets.
history: How does actual best cost change during SA
history_note: Solid line: best SA cost at each temperature stage. Dashed line: selected PPO final cost. Lower is better. This is not a shared training-time axis. The proposal slider retains the first 24 proposals, each new best and the final proposal; iteration gaps remain visible.
net_table: How do the final layouts score each net
code: Which source implements scoring and proposal acceptance
running: Comparison is still running; completed cases are available.
